title: Sr. Lead Engineer, Integration & Automation
eligibility_reason: US remote: US Remote; posting lists eligible states without Maine
description:
Ready to be a Titan?
ServiceTitan's Finance Business Technology team is seeking a Sr Lead engineer , Integration & Automations to serve as the technical cornerstone of our integration and automation practice. This is a newly created role designed to elevate the maturity, reliability, and strategic impact of our integration estate across Finance, Revenue, Billing, People Technology, and Go-to-Market.
You will own the end-to-end technical vision for how our enterprise systems connect - spanning Workday Financials, Workday HCM, Workato, Salesforce, and a growing ecosystem of SaaS platforms. You will set and enforce engineering standards, lead architecture reviews, and serve as the primary technical partner to senior Finance, HR, and GTM stakeholders. You will also partner with and technically guide a cross-functional team of integration engineers and automation specialists across US and India-based pods.
This role is equal parts architect, technical lead, and team enabler. You will report directly to the Director of G&A Systems and play a central role in driving our AI and Automation goals.
What you'll do:
Technical Leadership & Architecture
Define and maintain the integration architecture across Finance, Revenue, People Tech, and Go-to-Market domains, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards
Author and enforce integration design guidelines, coding standards, SLAs, and tiering frameworks based on business criticality - including patterns for error handling, idempotency, retry logic, and alerting
Lead architecture reviews for all net-new integrations and significant enhancements across the team's functional pods; own the final technical design decision on high-complexity builds
Evaluate and recommend tools, platforms, and integration patterns to support the evolving roadmap; assess build-vs-configure tradeoffs across iPaaS, native connectors, and custom API development
Conduct an audit of the current integration estate, identify technical debt and failure-prone patterns, and build and execute a prioritized hardening roadmap
Define and evolve the integration tier model - classifying integrations by business criticality and enforcing appropriate monitoring, SLA, and change management standards for each tier
Hands-On Engineering
Optimize and maintain complex integrations in Workday Studio (EIB, Core Connectors, Document Transformation, XSLT) and Workato, including net-new builds and major refactors of existing integrations
Develop reusable integration components, transformation templates, and shared libraries that reduce build time and enforce consistency across the team
Build and maintain API-based integrations connecting Workday, Salesforce, Snowflake, Avalara, Workato, and other platforms using REST/SOAP, JSON/XML, OAuth, and event-driven patterns
Own integration monitoring and alerting - instrumenting integrations with proactive health checks and ensuring failures surface before stakeholders notice them
Perform deep root cause analysis on critical integration failures; produce post-incident documentation and implement systemic fixes to prevent recurrence
Team Leadership & Development
Partner with the Manager to recruit, onboard, and develop integration talent across US and India-based pods
Run Integration & Automation grooming sessions - the biweekly stakeholder-facing forum where new integration requests are triaged, scoped, and sized before entering the cross-functional prioritization process
Serve as the L3 escalation point for integration incidents across all pods; ensure root cause analysis and preventive follow-up are completed for all critical failures
Foster a culture of documentation, runbook discipline, and knowledge sharing across onshore and offshore team members
Automation Program
Partner with the Manager to drive the AI and automation delivery pipeline, ensuring the backlog is continuously groomed and prioritized by impact
Identify and champion high-value automation opportunities surfaced through stakeholder grooming sessions and the automation initiative pipeline
Ensure all automation solutions are production-grade - monitored, documented, and resilient to upstream sys [...] doption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.
